Fairmont Doha embodies the spirit of grand hospitality, blending contemporary style with the warmth and energy for which the Fairmont brand is celebrated worldwide. With a focus on exceptional service, vibrant guest experiences, and a deep sense of place, Fairmont creates unforgettable stays for today’s global traveler. Together, Raffles & Fairmont Doha provide a dynamic and inspiring environment for hospitality professionals who are passionate about excellence. Joining our team means becoming part of a culture that values individuality, nurtures talent, and empowers colleagues to create remarkable experiences every day. About The Application Process At Raffles & Fairmont Doha, we want to bring out your highest potential. Shortly after applying, you will receive an email from our partner AssessFirst prompting you to create a profile and complete a questionnaire. This is a mandatory step for your candidacy to be considered as it enables us to explore your compatibility with this role and our culture of luxury excellence. Job Description We invite you to join the world of luxury hospitality at Raffles & Fairmont Doha as our new Assistant Banquet Manager. The Assistant Banquet Manager at Raffles Doha and Fairmont Doha is responsible for coordinating and managing corporate events, conferences, meetings, exhibitions, incentive groups, and social functions. The role supports the MICE Sales and Events teams in delivering exceptional guest experiences, maximizing event revenue, and ensuring seamless coordination between clients and hotel departments in line with the luxury standards of both brands. Key Responsibilities: Oversee the operational planning and execution of meetings, conferences, exhibitions, incentive groups, and corporate events Coordinate with Banquets, Food & Beverage, Culinary, Front Office, Housekeeping, and AV/IT teams to ensure seamless event delivery Prepare and review Banquet Event Orders (BEOs), function sheets, event schedules, and operational checklists Conduct pre-event briefings and communicate client requirements, event timelines, and service expectations to all relevant departments Supervise event setup, room layouts, audiovisual requirements, signage, and overall venue readiness Monitor event operations to ensure adherence to established service standards and client specifications Conduct regular inspections of meeting rooms, conference facilities, and event spaces to ensure readiness and presentation Manage last-minute changes, operational challenges, and special requests efficiently Ensure smooth coordination of group arrivals, accommodation requirements, meeting schedules, and transportation arrangements Monitor food and beverage service delivery, banquet operations, and event flow throughout each function Ensure compliance with health, safety, hygiene, and security procedures during events Handle client concerns and resolve operational issues promptly to maintain guest satisfaction Monitor event resources, equipment availability, staffing levels, and operational efficiency Supervise and support event team members, ensuring clear task allocation and consistent service delivery Conduct post-event reviews, gather client feedback, and identify opportunities for operational improvement Maintain accurate event documentation, operational reports, and departmental records Ensure all events reflect the luxury service standards and brand expectations of Raffles Doha and Fairmont Doha Qualifications What will you bring to this role? Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Hospitality Management, Hotel Administration, or a related field Minimum 3–5 years of experience in MICE operations, banquet operations, conference services, or event management within a luxury hotel environment Previous supervisory or team leadership experience in meetings and events operations Strong knowledge of event planning, banquet operations, function room setups, and audiovisual requirements Experience coordinating with multiple hotel departments to ensure seamless event execution Proficiency in hotel management and event systems, such as Opera, Delphi, or equivalent platforms Excellent organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills Ability to manage multiple events simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Strong leadership skills with the ability to supervise, motivate, and develop team members Excellent guest relations skills and a commitment to luxury service standards Strong attention to detail, flexibility, and the ability to handle last-minute operational changes Good knowledge of health, safety, hygiene, and hotel operational procedures Fluency in English and Arabic languages Embrace the Raffles & Fairmont brand promise and luxury in your role and in all your interactions Foster an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued and respected Create an environment where colleagues are empowered, supported and recognized Additional Information Employee Benefits Join our team and enjoy a range of exclusive colleague perks, including complimentary upgrades, extended stays, discounted stays across Fairmont & Raffles properties , special dining and wellness discounts, and added luxuries to enhance your experience. We believe in taking care of our team, ensuring that your hard work is rewarded with exceptional benefits. Our Values Respect: We value the needs, ideas and individuality of others. We treat everyone with fairness and dignity. Excellence: We make genuine connections, and we cherish every opportunity to make the people around us feel special. Belonging: We celebrate our differences. We support each other and we always stand together. review_candidates.title: Assistant Account Manager (AAM)
review_candidates.description: About Signify Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond. At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career. Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world. More About The Role The Assistant Account Manager (AAM) supports the management and growth of strategic customer accounts while independently managing a portfolio of smaller, non-key accounts. The role combines direct commercial responsibility with the development of the strategic, analytical, and relationship management capabilities required for a Key Account Manager role. The AAM progressively takes ownership of customer-facing activities, business planning, and commercial execution. This includes independently driving growth and commercial performance within assigned accounts, while supporting strategic key accounts under the guidance of a KAM. The AAM also plays an active role in store visits and in-store execution, working closely with the Marketing team to identify opportunities and improve brand and promotional execution at store level. The expectation is that, through demonstrated performance and continuous development, the AAM will be ready to assume a Key Account Manager position within approximately two years. Support the development and execution of strategic key customer account plans and growth initiatives. Independently manage and develop a portfolio of smaller, non-key customer accounts, with responsibility for commercial performance and growth. Build and maintain professional relationships with customer stakeholders. Regularly visit stores to assess in-store execution, identify opportunities, and actively drive improvements in collaboration with the Marketing team. Support preparation and coordination of promotions for key accounts, ensuring effective planning, execution, and follow-up, Prepare customer analyses, business reviews, and commercial recommendations to support decision-making for key accounts. Participate in customer negotiations, projects, and business reviews, taking on increasing responsibility over time. Demonstrate continuous development of strategic selling, account management, and leadership capabilities in preparation for a Key Account Manager role. More About You While we value and appreciate all applicants, we believe that the following experience and skills will be needed to shine brightly in this job opening: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field to ensure foundational knowledge in sales and customer relationship management. Minimum 2 years of experience in sales support or customer service roles, with hands-on experience in CRM systems and sales reporting. Proficiency certification in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics) is essential to effectively manage customer databases and reporting tools. Everything we’ll do for you You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together. Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

Otimizar a priorização dos pedidos, garantindo maior eficiência no fluxo produtivo. Assegurar a distribuição eficiente dos pedidos entre a produção interna e a produção externa (facção). Disseminar o conhecimento técnico da área, promovendo o desenvolvimento da equipe e a padronização das melhores práticas. DESCRIÇÃO Liderar as atividades de Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP), com foco no balanceamento estratégico dos processos, na definição das prioridades de produção e na distribuição otimizada dos pedidos entre a produção interna e a externa, contribuindo para o cumprimento dos prazos, a eficiência operacional e os resultados da empresa. RESPONSABILIDADES Coordenar o balanceamento dos processos de Planejamento e Controle da Produção, otimizando recursos e assegurando o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos. Definir, revisar e acompanhar a ordem de prioridade dos pedidos, considerando critérios de urgência, complexidade e capacidade produtiva. Planejar e realizar a distribuição estratégica dos pedidos entre a produção interna e a produção externa (facção), negociando prazos e acompanhando sua execução. Monitorar e analisar os indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) da área, propondo ações de melhoria para aumentar a eficiência, a produtividade e o cumprimento dos prazos. Desenvolver, implementar e aperfeiçoar métodos, processos e ferramentas de Planejamento e Controle da Produção. Atuar na resolução de problemas críticos relacionados à produção, propondo soluções rápidas e eficazes para minimizar impactos operacionais. Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento com a liderança e as equipes operacionais, apresentando análises, relatórios e informações que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Desenvolver e disseminar o conhecimento técnico da área, capacitando a equipe de PCP e promovendo a adoção das melhores práticas. Cumprir as normas, os procedimentos e as políticas internas, mantendo o ambiente de trabalho organizado, limpo e em conformidade com os padrões da empresa. Experiência: Vivência em Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP), com experiência nas atividades inerentes à função. This role ensures that air systems meet performance, safety, regulatory, and certification requirements while functioning seamlessly with other aircraft systems. The position involves close collaboration with multidisciplinary engineering teams, suppliers, and certification authorities. Key Responsibilities: System Design & Integration Lead the integration of aircraft air systems, including environmental control systems, bleed air, cabin pressurization, and related subsystems. Ensure proper interfaces and functional compatibility between air systems and other aircraft systems (structur es, avionics, propulsion, fuel, etc.). Develop and maintain system architecture, specifications, and interface control documents (ICDs). Performance & Technical Analysis Perform system-level analyses (thermal, pressure, airflow, fault scenarios) to validate design compliance with technical and operational requirements. Support trade studies and design optimization activities to meet weight, cost, reliability, and performance targets. Review and approve technical data, drawings, and software delivered by internal teams and external suppliers. Verification, Validation & Certification Define system requirements and verification plans in accordance with certification regulations (e.g., applicable civil aviation standards). Support ground and flight test activities, including preparation, execution support, and post-test analysis. Collaborate with certification and airworthiness teams to support compliance findings and regulatory documentation. Supplier & Stakeholder Collaboration Serve as a technical focal point for air system suppliers, supporting development, issue resolution, and technical reviews. Work closely with manufacturing, procurement, program management, and in-service support teams to ensure design maturity and producibility. Support configuration control, change management, and concession activities. Problem Resolution & Continuous Improvement Investigate and resolve design, integration, and in-service issues related to air systems. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives, lessons learned, and best practices within systems engineering. Basic Requirements: Education Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline. Experience 5+ years of experience in aircraft systems engineering, integration, or design, preferably within a regulated aerospace environment. Hands-on experience with air systems, environmental control systems, or pneumatic systems is highly desirable. Exposure to aircraft development programs, certification activities, or in-service support is an advantage. Technical Skills Strong understanding of aircraft systems integration principles and system engineering processes. Experience with requirements management, interface definition, and verification/validation activities. Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and technical specifications. Familiarity with aerospace standards, certification practices, and safety assessment processes. Tools & Methods Experience with engineering tools for requirements management, system modeling, and configuration management. Knowledge of CAD environments and basic simulation or analysis tools is an asset. Proficiency with standard office and documentation tools. Soft Skills Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, in a technical environment. Ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary and multicultural teams. Organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities . Extra Skills: Master’s degree is considered an asset. French considered an asset
